name: [Review before activation] Pharma QA Job Engine

parameters.content:
## Pharma QA Job Engine
Paste a job link/text into the form. The engine:
1. Builds a deduped record (source_id from the link/text).
2. Uses an AI agent to extract facts (never invents contacts/dates/salary), score 0-100,
   and prepare ATS resume, cover letter, LinkedIn content, recruiter keywords, outreach
   draft, and interview Q&A — only for relevant pharma QA roles.
3. Filters out non-pharma-QA / wrong-experience jobs.
4. Upserts into the "Pharma QA Jobs" data table (re-submitting the same link updates it).

Note: automated scraping of LinkedIn/Naukri/Indeed/Foundit is not reliable — those
sites block bots. This engine is the paste-in intake + processing core.

parameters.formDescription: Paste a job link and/or the job text. The engine filters, scores, dedupes, and prepares resume + interview content, then saves it to your Pharma QA Jobs table.

values.placeholder: Paste the full job posting / walk-in notice text here (company, role, experience, location, dates, contacts).
e.g. seen on Naukri / company site

values.formSubmittedText: Got it. The job is being analyzed, scored, and prepared. Check your "Pharma QA Jobs" data table for the result.

options.systemMessage:
You are a pharma job-search analyst and career-content assistant.
You receive raw text (and maybe a link) describing ONE job opening.

CANDIDATE PROFILE (the person you are helping):
- Diploma in Biotechnology, Parul University, India
- 2 years experience in Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance (QA)
- Hands-on exposure to Tablet Compression / OSD (Oral Solid Dosage) manufacturing
- Target locations: Vadodara, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, and nearby India
- Goal: get a pharma QA job fast with minimum manual effort

TARGET ROLES (only these count as relevant):
QA Executive / Officer, IPQA Executive / Officer, Production QA, Manufacturing QA,
Documentation QA, QC Support, BMR/BPR Review, Line Clearance / In-process Quality,
OSD / Tablet manufacturing roles.

STRICT RULES:
1. NEVER guess or invent emails, phone numbers, WhatsApp numbers, interview dates,
   times, venues, salary/CTC, or addresses. Only extract details that are EXPLICITLY
   present in the provided text. If a detail is not present, output the exact string
   "not verified". Do not fabricate anything.
2. Only treat the job as relevant if it is a pharmaceutical QA-type role from the target
   list AND the experience requirement is compatible with ~2 years (accept ranges like
   1-3, 2-5, 2-7, or "2 years"). Set is_relevant=false for unrelated roles, wrong
   experience bands, or non-pharma jobs.
3. opportunity_type must be one of: "walk-in", "direct vacancy", "upcoming interview",
   or "unknown". Prefer "walk-in" when a walk-in/interview drive is described.
4. verification_status must be one of: "verified" (official company source with clear
   contact/details), "partially verified" (some details present, others missing), or
   "not verified" (third-party repost or little detail).
5. match_score is an integer 0-100 combining: role match, experience match, location
   match, QA/IPQA relevance, OSD/tablet-compression fit, salary clarity, company
   quality, and hiring urgency (walk-ins and near-term interviews score higher).
6. Only produce rich career content (resume_summary, resume_bullets, cover_letter,
   linkedin_headline, linkedin_about, recruiter_keywords, outreach_draft, interview_qa)
   when is_relevant=true. For irrelevant jobs, set those fields to empty strings/arrays.
7. Career content must be ATS-optimized, factual to the candidate profile above, and
   must NOT invent employers, certifications, or years the candidate does not have.
8. outreach_draft: a short, professional message the candidate could send ONLY to a
   verified contact. Do NOT include any invented contact address inside it.
9. interview_qa: concise question + model-answer pairs covering GMP, GDP, QA/IPQA,
   Tablet Compression, Documentation, BMR/BPR, Deviation, CAPA, Change Control, and
   Data Integrity / ALCOA+, tailored to this role.

Use "not verified" for any missing factual detail. Respond ONLY with the structured
JSON object required by the output format.

parameters.jsCode:
const na = 'not verified';
const data = ($json.output && typeof $json.output === "object") ? $json.output : {};
const build = $('Build Job Record').item.json;
const joinArr = (v) => Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(v.length && String(v[0]).length < 40 ? ", " : "\n") : (v || "");
return {
  source_id: build.source_id,
  source: build.source,
  raw_text: build.raw_text,
  apply_link: data.apply_link || build.apply_link || na,
  company_name: data.company_name || na,
  job_title: data.job_title || na,
  department: data.department || '',
  location: data.location || '',
  exact_address: data.exact_address || na,
  walkin_date: data.walkin_date || na,
  walkin_time: data.walkin_time || na,
  walkin_venue: data.walkin_venue || na,
  contact_email: data.contact_email || na,
  contact_phone: data.contact_phone || na,
  contact_whatsapp: data.contact_whatsapp || na,
  experience_required: data.experience_required || na,
  salary_ctc: data.salary_ctc || na,
  company_type: data.company_type || na,
  opportunity_type: data.opportunity_type || 'unknown',
  match_score: typeof data.match_score === 'number' ? data.match_score : 0,
  score_reasoning: data.score_reasoning || '',
  verification_status: data.verification_status || na,
  is_relevant: data.is_relevant === true,
  resume_summary: data.resume_summary || '',
  resume_bullets: joinArr(data.resume_bullets),
  cover_letter: data.cover_letter || '',
  linkedin_headline: data.linkedin_headline || '',
  linkedin_about: data.linkedin_about || '',
  recruiter_keywords: joinArr(data.recruiter_keywords),
  outreach_draft: data.outreach_draft || '',
  interview_qa: data.interview_qa || '',
  processed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
};
